verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair ask for a database product, so the axis applies. The docs list single-tenant and BYOC deployment alongside the default multi-tenant service, but the evidence describes no install path and a community commenter notes the product is source-unavailable, so users cannot run it themselves. Vendor-operated BYOC is a related deployment mode, not self-hosting, so no credit attaches (corrected 2026-11-01 per the prompt-v5 own-capability rule; PR #563 review).
